point: 提出“屏蔽学习(shielded learning)”框架:给定时序逻辑规约,综合一个叫 shield 的反应式系统,在学习与执行阶段强制安全。
quote_en: given the temporal logic specification that is to be obeyed by the learning system, we propose to synthesize a reactive system called a shield

point: shield 有两种接入方式之一:抢占式——每次学习者要决策前,shield 给出一份安全动作清单。
quote_en: In the first one, the shield acts each time the learning agent is about to make a decision and provides a list of safe actions.

point: 第二种是后置式——shield 监视学习者选的动作,只有当所选动作会违反规约时才纠正它。
quote_en: the shield monitors the actions from the learner and corrects them only if the chosen action causes a violation of the specification

point: shield 由安全规约 + 环境抽象通过反应式综合(reactive synthesis)预先算出,保证安全且“最小干预”。
quote_en: The shield is computed upfront from the safety part of the given system specification and an abstraction of the agent's environment dynamics. It ensures safety and minimum interference.

point: “最小干预”定义:shield 尽量少地限制 agent,只在动作可能危及系统安全时才禁止。
quote_en: With minimum interference we mean that the shield restricts the agent as little as possible and forbids actions only if they could endanger safe system behavior.

point: 规约语言采用时序逻辑的“安全片段(safety fragment)”。
quote_en: we focus on the so-called safety fragment of (linear) temporal logic

point: 形式化定义“安全强化学习”:在学习与执行阶段都满足时序逻辑安全规约 φs 的前提下学到最优策略。
quote_en: Safe reinforcement learning is the process of learning an optimal pol- icy while satisfying a temporal logic safety specification φs during the learning and execution phases.

point: shield 合成算法第一步:把安全规约自动机 φs 和 MDP 抽象 φM 翻译成一个两玩家安全博弈 G;环境玩家选观测、系统玩家选动作。
quote_en: We translate φs and φM to a safety game G = (G, g0, ΣI, ΣO, δ, Fg) between two players. In the game, the environment player chooses the next observations from the MDP state (i.e., elements from L), and the system chooses the next action.

point: 第二步:用标准安全博弈求解算出获胜区域 W;shield 允许的动作正是那些“无论下一步观测如何都能保持在 W 内”的动作,因而是抽象意义下的最小干预。
quote_en: The shield allows all actions that are guaranteed to lead to a state in W, no matter what the next observation is.

point: shield 的关键能力是“向前规划”:它绝不允许进入“环境可以强迫将来到达不安全状态”的状态,从而提前避险(如汽车需远在悬崖前就减速)。
quote_en: it can never allow the play to visit a state from which the environment can force the play to visit an unsafe state in the future

point: 后置式 shield 对被改写的不安全动作有两种 reward 处理之一:给不安全动作记惩罚,则不保证最终策略已排除不安全动作,故 shield 在学习阶段之后仍须保持激活。
quote_en: there is no guarantee that unsafe actions are not part of the final policy. Therefore, the shield has to remain active even after the learning phase.

point: 后置式给出排序版:agent 给动作排名 rank_t,shield 选 rank 中第一个安全动作;只有全部都不安全时才偏离排名另选安全动作。
quote_en: The shield selects the first action at = a^i_t that is allowed by φs. Only if all actions in rank_t are unsafe, the shield is allowed to deviate and to select a safe action al ∉ rank_t.

point: 理论结果:证明了所算 shield 满足正确性(correctness)与最小干预(minimal interference)两条性质。
quote_en: We now prove that the shields computed according to the definitions indeed have the claimed properties, namely correctness, and minimal interference.

point: 收敛性结论:可构造 shield 与 MDP 的乘积 MDP M',因此凡是在标准 MDP 上收敛的学习算法,在 shield 存在下也能被证明收敛。
quote_en: Since M′ is a standard MDP, all learning algorithms that converge on standard MDPs can be shown to converge in the presence of a shield under this construction.

point: 水箱例子:规约自动机与 MDP 抽象的乘积博弈有 602 个状态(把所有错误态并成一个、所有 paradise 态并成一个之后)。
quote_en: Building the product game between the specification automaton and the MDP abstraction leads to a game with 602 states

point: 水箱 shield 会强制:水位过低时开进水阀直到至少到 4,且水位高于 93 时禁止开阀(因阀至少要开三步、进水可达2L/s 而出水可为0,否则会溢出)。
quote_en: it will also prevent the inflow from being opened when the level is above 93

point: 在四个领域上演示:9x9/15x9 网格世界机器人、自动驾驶汽车、Atari 游戏 Seaquest、以及水箱例子。
quote_en: We applied shielded reinforcement learning in four domains: (1) a robot in 9x9 and 15x9 grid worlds, (2) a self-driving car scenario, (3) an Atari® game called SeaquestTM, and (4) the water tank example from Section 4.

point: 网格世界用表格 Q-learning + ε-greedy 探索,支持一次多次策略更新;9x9 的 shield(由 φs1∧φs2 + 精确抽象)2 秒合成,15x9 的(由 φs1 + 精确抽象,防撞墙与撞移动对手)0.6 秒合成。
quote_en: In the 9x9 grid-world, we synthesized a shield from φs1 ∧ φs2 and the (precise) environment abstraction in 2 seconds. In the 15x9 experiment, we synthesized a shield from the (precise) environment abstraction and φs1 to prevent crashes into the wall and the moving opponent agent in 0.6 seconds.

point: 网格世界(图11):只有无屏蔽版本会出现负奖励;屏蔽版本不仅安全,而且往往学得更快。
quote_en: Fig. 11 shows that only the unshielded versions experience negative rewards. Furthermore, the shielded versions are not only safe, but also tend to learn more rapidly.

point: 自动驾驶例:480x480 环境,每步前进 3 像素、最大转向 7.5 度;离墙小于 60 像素触发 shield 输入;agent 用 DQN + Boltzmann 探索;抢占式与后置式 shield 均 2 秒合成。
quote_en: Both of the preemptive and the post-posed shields were synthesized in 2 seconds.

point: 自动驾驶结果(图12):无屏蔽版奖励虽随时间上升但仍会在仿真末段撞墙;无惩罚的屏蔽版学得更快且从不撞车。
quote_en: The shielded version without punishment (blue, solid) learns more rapidly than the unshielded learning scenario and never crashes.

point: Atari Seaquest:agent 当黑盒,shield 只改违反规约的动作;两条安全性质为“氧气耗尽前必须上浮(φs1)”“氧气足且尚未救到潜水员时不许上浮(φs2)”。
quote_en: First, the submarine has to surface before oxygen runs out (φs1). Secondly, the submarine is not allowed to surface if it has enough oxygen but has not collected any divers yet (φs2).

point: Atari 结果(图13):屏蔽未改变学习者的性能,但屏蔽后 φs1∧φs2 不再被违反。
quote_en: shielding the learner did not change its performance, however, the safety properties φs1 ∧ φs2 were not violated when shielding the learner

point: 水箱例:后置式 shield 不到一秒合成;图14 显示屏蔽与非屏蔽的 Q-learning、SARSA 都达到最优策略,但屏蔽实现到达最优所用时间明显更短。
quote_en: both shielded (dashed lines) and unshielded Q-learning and SARSA experiments (solid lines) do reach an optimal policy. However, the shielded implementations reach the optimal policy in a significantly shorter time than the unshielded implementations.

point: 总结性结论:在所有场景中屏蔽 agent 至少与非屏蔽一样好,多数情况下还改善了学习性能。
quote_en: In all of them, the shielded agents perform at least as well as the unshielded ones. In most cases, our approach even improved the learning performance.

point: 作者自述主要缺点:为阻止不安全动作,必须事先有一个“何种动作在何时不安全”的近似模型(环境抽象)。
quote_en: The main downside of our approach is that in order to prevent the learner from making unsafe actions, some approximate model of when which action is unsafe needs to be available.

point: shield 只依赖被监控的输入-输出行为、环境抽象与正确性规约,与底层学习算法的内部细节无关(因而兼容函数逼近)。
quote_en: A shield depends only on the monitored input-output behavior, the environment abstraction, and the correctness specifications – it is independent of the intricate details of the underlying learning algorithm.
